results.title: President Trump says he will order American forces to hold off on new strikes against Iran
results.description: The emerging deal “would include the Immediate, Complete, and Total OPENING OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT, and an end to Iran’s nuclear threat,” Trump wrote Saturday.

results.title: K'taka all-party meet on Cauvery dispute underway; CM Shivakumar seeks united stand
results.description: Stressing that drinking water remains the top priority, Shivakumar appealed for political unity and urged protesters to withdraw their agitation, saying water must be released once the Kabini reservoir reaches full capacity.
